'''Lan Tundi''' was an [[Ore/Legends|ore]]-rich [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Lan system]]. Though its barren surface could not support life, underground [[Miner/Legends|mining]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonies]] had been constructed on the planet by the [[Imperial Era/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During that time, the export of ore from mines on Lan Tundi and the other inner planets was the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] only real source of income.

==Description==
Lan Tundi was the third [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Lan (star)|Lan]]<ref name="Journal 1" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]]<ref name="TEA-OC" /> [[Lan system]]. It had four [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and was situated within the [[Hook Nebula/Legends|Hook Nebula]]. The planet's barren, [[Stone/Legends|rocky]] surface was incapable of supporting life; however, Lan Tundi&mdash;like the other inner terrestrial planets of the [[Star system/Legends|system]]&mdash;had abundant [[Ore/Legends|ore]] deposits.<ref name="Journal 1" />

==History==
[[File:Qieg-AE.png|thumb|right|300px|The Qieg species (pictured) was part of the Human-Qieg Guild that oversaw mining on Lan Tundi.]]
The Lan system and Lan Tundi were discovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Journal 1" /> around [[1300 BBY/Legends|1300 BBY]].<ref name="Date">"[[Lan Barell (article)|Lan Barell]]" dates the discovery of the [[Lan system]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to around 1,300 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]], which equates to around [[1300 BBY/Legends|1300 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref>  Soon after, the [[Gaminne Group, Inc.]]&mdash;a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] conglomerate&mdash;purchased the system's [[Miner/Legends|mining]] rights from the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Qieg/Legends|Qieg]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the system's fourth planet, [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]].<ref name="Journal 1" />

The Qieg and a group of Human [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] eventually formed a stable government, the [[Human-Qieg Guild]], to administer the entire system, including Lan Tundi. By the [[Imperial Era/Legends|time]] the Galactic Republic had been [[Declaration of a New Order|reorganized]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], pressurized and underground mining colonies had been constructed on Lan Tundi to facilitate its continued extraction of ore. Various companies under the supervision of the Human-Qieg government worked the mines, which provided the system's only real source of income.<ref name="Journal 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lan Tundi was first mentioned in "[[Lan Barell (article)|Lan Barell]]," a ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' source article published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 1|first installment]] of the [[West End Games]] magazine ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''. The article was written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and released in [[February]] [[1994]].<ref name="AdventureJournal">{{JournalCite|1|Lan Barell (article)}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Lan system, and therefore Lan Tundi, in grid square O-18.<ref name="Atlas" />
